bill_text.text_with_changes:
A House resolution recognizing Minnesota's Year of Water.

WHEREAS, water shapes Minnesota's identity, economy, culture, and quality of life; and
WHEREAS, Minnesota's lakes, rivers, wetlands, groundwater, and drinking water systems are shared resources that connect communities across geography and generations; and
WHEREAS, Minnesotans from across the state, including rural and urban communities, landowners, educators, youth, civic organizations, and local leaders, have demonstrated broad interest in elevating water as a shared public value; and
WHEREAS, stewardship of water is strengthened when citizens, communities, and public institutions work together voluntarily and locally; and
WHEREAS, recognition of water as a shared inheritance offers an opportunity to unite Minnesotans across differences without creating mandates, policy directives, or fiscal obligations; NOW, THEREFORE,
BE IT RESOLVED by the House of Representatives of the State of Minnesota that it recognizes June 1, 2026, through May 31, 2027, as Minnesota's Year of Water.
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that this recognition is intended to encourage voluntary civic awareness, local participation, and public celebration of Minnesota's waters.
